# Module report — M1 Permissions & roles core (T-008) — 2026-10-28

## Built
- **Static route-guard invariant test** (`tests/permissions.test.ts`): every `Routes.(get|post|put|patch|delete)` registration across `server/routes/*.ts` must carry `requirePermission`/`requireAuth` on its line or belong to the documented allowlist (login/MFA-verify/setup*, search at router level — the search router's `use('*', requireAuth)` is asserted separately and fails if removed). Foundation for catching future unguarded routes in CI.
- **Role matrix invariant tests** (8 cases): owner/admin hold every declared permission; `permissionsForRole` never contains an undeclared permission; **viewer strictly read-only** (no `.write`, no `.delete`, no users.*); **only owner/admin/accountant control periods** (sales/viewer denied both read and write there — journal/users excluded from sales & viewer per the personal-data design); user management `users.write` denied to every non-admin; unknown permission denied; `assertPermission` throws ApiError 403.
- `@types/node` added as devDependency and `node` added to `tsconfig.server.json` types (tests compile).

## Result of the sweep
- **No missing server-side permission check found.** 5 enumerations had no per-line guard; 4 are the by-design public authentication/setup endpoints; the 5th (global search) is guarded at router level with `requireAuth` and now locked by a test.
- Verified matrix matches the confirmed OQ-021 default (exception: accountant's period control — consistent with the audit's design note).

## Tests run and results
- Full suite: **3 files, all pass** (incl. 10 new permission tests; total 59).
- `npm run typecheck` clean; `npm run build` clean.
- **Live negatives [EXECUTED]** (local runtime): sales DELETE invoice → 403 (has write, lacks delete); sales GET invoices → 200; viewer POST clients → 403; viewer PATCH settings → 403; accountant POST users → 403; accountant PATCH settings → 403 (settings.write reserved); accountant GET numbering → 200; accountant PUT numbering → 403 (from M0, unchanged).

## Deviations / defects
- None in the application. Test-side corrections during writing: matrix expectations aligned with the accountant's period-control design (user directory + journal + period closure deliberately excluded from non-admin and view roles — documentation kept).
